author: agent
statement: Defer the Run 114 Probe queue diagnostic after bounding local identity dispatch. FIFO, oldest-release, and highest-priority improve only the maximum per-lot wait by redistributing one fixed 33.932 s busy-wave queue; they do not reduce the exact contributor, total cycle, WIP, delivery, or any locked-case score. Combined with the retained Probe-cycle negative result, neither local speed nor local identity order converts the upstream quality gain into factory value. Reopen only with a physically distinct downstream service-phase hypothesis that improves total queue, cycle, WIP, or delivery rather than moving wait among source lots; keep the measured Probe queue visible in Analysis.
